entities.summary: Souad Mohammad Sabah Al-Mohammad Al-Sabah is a Kuwaiti economist, writer and poet. She is also recognized as the widow of Abdullah Mubarak Al-Sabah, the youngest son of Mubarak Al-Sabah, credited with founding modern Kuwait.
